result.detail:
No formal_spec (.sby) is included, so formal.run and formal.cover do not apply to this submission. Section 8 of the interface spec and the verification plan in the microarchitecture both ask for an unbounded proof at N=8 and N=32. That remains an open item, best handled as a separate task so it does not risk this submission's gates.

The FORMAL-guarded assertions in the RTL cover only combinational output rules and are not executed by any gate in this task.

No file has a timescale directive, so Verilator does not raise a TIMESCALEMOD mismatch.

The testbench drives the bus and pins at negedge or posedge+1, so there are no sampling races. Each transfer's setup phase starts in the cycle right after the previous completion, so consecutive calls are back-to-back.
